scan.heading: Scan
regions.title: Scan Regions
scan.hint.value_int: Decimal or 0x hexadecimal. Expressions are allowed, e.g. 360 * (10 ^ 6) (Lua syntax).
scan.hint.value_float: Decimal or scientific notation (1.5e3). Expressions are allowed, e.g. 10 / 4.
scan.hint.value_text: Text to search for; surrounding quotes are optional.
scan.hint.value_aob: Array of Bytes (AOB) searches for a byte pattern in memory. Separate hex bytes with spaces or commas; ? and ?? match any byte. Example: 48 8B ?? E5 (compact 488B??E5 also works).
scan.hint.value_binary: Bit pattern. Separate bytes with spaces and use ? for a wildcard bit. Example: 1010??11.
scan.hint.compare: Comparison used for an exact scan: == != > >= < <= (also eq ne gt ge lt le).
scan.hint.scan_type: What to match on this scan: an exact value, an increase or decrease, a change, or an unknown initial value.
scan.hint.value_type: How to read the bytes in memory. Choose Array of Bytes to search for a byte pattern with wildcards.
scan.hint.hex: Interpret the scan value as hexadecimal. Applies only to integer types and a bare literal; expressions are unaffected.
scan.hint.writable: Only scan memory regions that are writable.
scan.hint.alignment: Only match addresses that are a multiple of this value. 0 uses the value type's size.
scan.hint.scope: Which memory regions the scan covers. Ignored when specific regions are selected.
scan.hint.speedhack: Scale the target's time functions. Requires attaching with ptrace.
scan.hint.speedhack_scale: Time multiplier: 2 runs the target twice as fast, 0.5 half as fast.
scan.hint.first: Start a new scan from scratch.
scan.hint.next: Filter the previous results with the current scan type.
scan.hint.undo: Step back to the previous result set.
scan.hint.regions: Choose the exact memory regions to scan.
results.hint.add_to_table: Add the selected scan result to the cheat table.
results.hint.add_address: Add an address manually, optionally with pointer offsets.
results.hint.clear: Remove every entry from the cheat table.

debugger.title: Debugger
debugger.no_watchpoints: this backend does not support hardware watchpoints
debugger.call_args_placeholder: one per line: int:123, float:1.5, double:2.5
debugger.hint.address: Breakpoint/watch address. Accepts hexadecimal (0x...) or decimal.
debugger.hint.attach: Attach the debugger to the selected process, pausing it.
debugger.hint.detach: Detach and let the process continue.
debugger.hint.continue: Resume execution until the next breakpoint.
debugger.hint.step_over: Run to the next instruction, stepping over calls.
debugger.hint.call: Call a function in the target with typed arguments.
debugger.hint.toggle_breakpoint: Set or clear an INT3 breakpoint at the address.
debugger.hint.find_writes: Watch the address for writes (hardware watchpoint).
debugger.hint.find_accesses: Watch the address for reads and writes.
debugger.hint.stop_watch: Remove the watchpoint at the address.
debugger.hint.register_edit: Edit a register as NAME=value, e.g. RAX=0x10.
dissect.hint.base: Base address to dissect. Accepts hexadecimal (0x...) or decimal.
dissect.hint.size: Number of bytes to lay out as fields.
dissect.hint.instance: Address of another instance to show as an extra column.
dissect.hint.dissect: Read and lay out the memory range as typed fields.
dissect.hint.add_instance: Add the instance address as a new column.
dissect.hint.edit: Write a new value at the selected field.
dissect.hint.follow: Follow a pointer field to the address it points to.
customtypes.hint.name: Unique name of the value type.
customtypes.hint.mode: Script language used by the type: Lua or Auto Assembler.
customtypes.hint.size: Size in bytes of one value.
customtypes.hint.kind: How the value is compared and formatted: int, float or string.
customtypes.hint.align: Scan alignment for this type. 0 uses the type's size.
customtypes.hint.desc: Optional description shown in the value type list.
customtypes.hint.test_bytes: Hex bytes to decode in the test bench.
customtypes.hint.test_addr: Read the test value from this address instead of the hex bytes (needs a process).
customtypes.hint.test: Run the conversion functions on the test input.
customtypes.hint.save: Register the type and write customtypes.yaml.
autoasm.hint.execute: Apply the [ENABLE] section of the script to the target.
autoasm.hint.revert: Undo the applied script and restore the original code.
editor.hint.find: Text to search for in the script.
editor.hint.replace: Replacement text used by Replace and All.
editor.hint.replace_all: Replace every match in the script.
editor.hint.comment: Toggle a -- comment on the selected lines.
